boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's os_ownerInfo.c, 0x02059eb0..0x02059f48: 2 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt, each identified by its body against pret's pokediamond OS_ownerInfo.c. OS_GetOwnerInfo copies the language, favourite colour, birthday, nickname and comment out of the NVRAM user-info block at 0x027ffc80, the strings by MIi_CpuCopy16 (MultiCopyHalf). OS_GetMacAddress copies the 6 bytes at 0x027ffcf4 by MI_CpuCopy8 (CpuCopy8).

Order: pret's file defines OS_GetMacAddress, OS_GetOwnerInfo and OS_GetOwnerRtcOffset. mwccarm emits the bodies in reverse, so OS_GetOwnerInfo is lowest and OS_GetMacAddress highest. OS_GetOwnerRtcOffset is absent: nothing in this game calls it, so the linker dropped it.
BOTTOM EDGE: OS_InitReset (0x02059e48..0x02059eb0), the highest of os_reset.c (arm9/OS_Reset).
TOP EDGE: MI_SetWramBank (0x02059f48..0x02059f58) is mi_wram.c, the whole of that SDK file, and stays its own source (src/MI_SetWramBank.c).
notes: Hand-assembled, following arm9/FS_Rom: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main.
func_02059f2c was renamed OS_GetMacAddress from its body in this change. symbols/actor_renames.tsv records the evidence. OS_GetOwnerInfo was already named.
